svg.title: Who wins with best play, by board size
svg.desc: A 10 by 10 heat map: pits a side across, seeds per pit up. Each square shows the first player's share of the seeds with perfect play by both, red where the first player wins by force and blue where the second does; thick lines mark where the winner changes.
svg.text: Who wins with best play, by board size
Each square: the first player's share of all the seeds when both sides play perfectly. Hatched: too big to solve exactly in
the budget, so the range it was narrowed to and, where proved, who wins. Standard rules otherwise. Thick lines: the winner changes.
PITS A SIDE (BETWEEN THE TWO STORES)
SEEDS IN EACH PIT AT THE START
75 of 100 boards solved exactly, 89 with the winner proved, by tools/solve/grid.ts (alpha-beta, every position remembered; checked against the game's own engine).
